The '''Husbandry Sack''' is a [[Sack]] unlocked in the {{LI|Raw Mutton}} collection at {{coll|Raw Mutton 2}}, {{coll|Raw Mutton 5}}, {{coll|Raw Mutton 7}}, {{coll|Raw Mutton 9}}, and {{Coll|Raw Mutton 10}} with increasing capacity. The {{ID|Beginner Husbandry Sack!Beginner Sack|nolink=y}} can hold {{Green|640}} of each item, the {{ID|Small Husbandry Sack!Small Sack|nolink=y}} can hold {{Green|2,240}} of each item, the {{ID|Medium Husbandry Sack!Medium Sack|nolink=y}} can hold {{Green|6,720}} of each item, and the {{ID|Large Husbandry Sack!Large Sack|nolink=y}} can hold {{Green|20,160}} of each item. {{ID|Large Enchanted Husbandry Sack!Large Enchanted Sack|nolink=y}} can hold {{Green|20,160}} of enchanted item. 

== Obtaining ==
=== Merchant ===
A '''Beginner Husbandry Sack''' can be bought for {{c|250}} at {{NPCSprite|Husbandry Merchant}} in the [[Barn]].
